links.note: Prospective fresh HKY executions on previously observed fixtures; the producer data and old interrupted queue are not retrospectively preregistered or resumed.

question: Do all 124 frozen Boolean branch verdicts independently replay through the HKY engine, and do fresh-process repetitions preserve closure ranks and verdicts under the same caps?

claims.text: For uncensored producer rows, independently built equations and bounded HKY verdicts agree on these exact original Boolean branches. A new result for the censored row never repairs its old unknown cost.
Repeated fresh processes preserve the full-column count, plain/closure ranks and verdict on every successfully completed matched pair.

arms.description: Independent HKY replay of every original (draw,k,branch) case.
Second fresh process on the identical frozen case; tests determinism, not timing noise.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Exact finite replay, not an empirical detector/population claim: all source fixtures have certified zero Boolean roots, every invocation rebuilds equations twice, uncensored producer verdicts are asserted, and the native unit suite checks positive algebraic and fail-closed parsing controls before execution. No detector-power generalization is made.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No claim about typical curves, a null population, degree growth or performance. The entire previously registered branch census is checked; nonrefuting fixed points and caps remain distinct from solutions.

factors.name: equations_inputs_and_branches
factors.how: Source JSONL hash and producer receipt hash pinned; two independent equation builders must agree.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: Binary SHA, build commit, Rust source SHA, toolchain and single-thread environment guarded before every case.

factors.name: process_layout
factors.how: Fresh OS process for every arm/case; operating-system ASLR is not seeded or used for selection.

factors.name: case_and_arm_order
factors.how: Case census order draw/k/branch; interleave both arms per case, alternate which arm starts by case ordinal.

factors.name: host_and_load
factors.how: Record CPU/kernel, CPU affinity, PSI/load and resource metadata; take the shared busy lock per native child. No clock is an experimental metric.

factors.name: resource_limits
factors.how: Same limits and binary on both arms; no timeout retry.

comparisons.threshold: Every248nativecase validates and every124A/A primary rank/verdict pair is exactly equal; no cost or statistical inference.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Alternate the first arm by case ordinal. Rank/verdict are exact; no timing comparison or cache-based benefit is inferred.

seed_derivation.note: The engine draws no target/algorithm randomness; all inputs and branch assignments already exist and are hash-pinned. Seed0 is a metadata sentinel, never a new draw.

instance_sampling.rule: Complete fixed census of 124 tuples; all four original draws0,3,5,6 and every branch at k0..4. Both arms receive identical tuples.

blinding.how: An exact deterministic verifier whose analysis and equality rules are frozen before fresh executions; no discretionary arm selection or statistical analysis.

power.note: Census of the fixed cases, not a population sample or significance test. Alpha is a required unused schema field. A/A assesses determinism only.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Not a measured pilot or expected runtime: conservative sum248×900s of the frozen per-child watchdogs. Existing historical producer data are not used as HKY timing estimates. Checkpoint/lock overhead is additional.

primary.name: closure rank
primary.definition: Exact native closure rank for the completed degree-four closure; no value is imputed on a cap/failure.

primary.name: full-column count
primary.definition: Exact native full-column count for the completed degree-four closure; no value is imputed on a cap/failure.

secondary.name: plain input rank
secondary.definition: Exact native plain input rank for the completed degree-four closure; no value is imputed on a cap/failure.

secondary.name: HKY closure rounds
secondary.definition: Exact native HKY closure rounds for the completed degree-four closure; no value is imputed on a cap/failure.

placement.scope: One local batch job; execution timeout is whole batch. Every child retains its original900-second watchdog.

stopping_rules.rule: Both arms on all124fixed cases =248fresh native child executions; no outcome-based early stopping. Every per-child cap is retained and never retried. Stop the batch on checkpoint/hash/restore failure.
Whole local batch outer watchdog250000s; per child900s with30s kill grace and8GiB address-space cap.

invalidation_rules: Missing/malformed output, wrong source/hash/tuple, builder disagreement, verdict disagreement with an uncensored source row, impossible ranks or invented independent words are invalid.
Every wall/CPU clock is invalid for performance inference. A/A primary rank/verdict disagreement is retained as a mismatch.
A producer timeout remains unknown in its original receipt regardless of a fresh independent classification.

decision_rule.text: Native fail-closed analysis retains all248case statuses. Full success requires every case output to validate and all124A/A rank/verdict pairs to agree; caps/errors are inconclusive and retained. Only complete registered-prefix families can have minima, never arbitrary subsets.
decision_rule.threshold: Exact finite equality and complete case coverage; no significance threshold.
decision_rule.statistic: Native verified/capped/error counts, exact rank/verdict equality and registered-prefix minima.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Not applicable: exact finite replication, no cost or population effect estimate.

outputs: Native replay-summary JSON, complete experiment.export/v1 and raw archive

graphs: Retained verified/capped/invalid outcomes by arm and draw; original producer unknowns shown separately.

inadmissible: Dropping any cap/failure or changing inputs, prefixes, limits, source, binary, ordering or primary checks after data.
Claiming an independent solver-word recount, full query/DLP price, arbitrary-subset minimum, degree law, timing gain or subgroup-security conclusion.
Retrospectively applying this freeze to original producer executions; manufacturing old queue completion markers; treating a parent disappearance as success.
